apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Not programming this. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag, not a training variable — I won't add threshold intervals on top of it.

See a doctor (cardiology workup) before your next run. No workout substitute for that.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

Still no. Exertional chest tightness that eases with rest is textbook cardiac red-flag territory — that pattern is exactly what needs a doctor to rule out, not reassurance from me. "Goes away when I stop" doesn't make it a fitness marker.

I won't schedule the intervals. Get cleared by a doctor first — after that I'll build the block.
